observations: Photo 0: Front view of a black Nikon DSLR camera with a lens attached. The camera body has 'Nikon' and 'D90' visible. The lens is labeled 'Nikon AF-P DX NIKKOR 18-55 VR'. The camera appears used, with some dust and wear.

Photo 1: Top view of the camera, showing the screen, control dials, and lens. The lens is clearly labeled 'Nikon AF-P DX NIKKOR 18-55 VR'. The camera body shows signs of use, including dust and minor scratches.

Photo 2: Rear view of the camera, showing the LCD screen, viewfinder, and buttons. The screen is off and appears dirty. The camera body has visible wear and dust. The lens is attached and appears intact.

claims.claim: This is a Used Nikon D90 DSLR Camera With 18-55MM lens
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show the Nikon D90 body with the 18-55mm lens attached. The model name is clearly visible on the body.
No photo shows the camera powered on or in use. The screen is off in photo 2, and no operation is visible. No proof of functionality is provided.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or function properly
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the camera turned on, screen lit, and taking a photo.

risks.risk: Lens may have internal damage or fungus not visible in photos
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lens glass, especially the front element, under bright light to check for haze or fungus.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens may be damaged

risks.risk: Camera may have sensor damage or scratches not visible in photos
risks.proof: Photo of the camera sensor with the lens removed, or a close-up of the sensor under bright light.
risks.if_unproven: priced as sensor may be damaged

risks.risk: Battery or charger may be missing or non-functional
risks.proof: Photo of the battery and charger, and a video showing the camera powering on with battery and charger.
risks.if_unproven: priced as battery and charger may be missing

proof_requests: Video or photo of the camera turned on and taking a photo.
Close-up photo of the lens glass under bright light to check for fungus or damage.
Photo of the camera sensor with the lens removed.
Photo of the battery and charger.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
